description: How the smartphone camera killed the compact camera — a unit-by-unit timeline (2006–2026). This dataset tracks global annual shipments (millions) from CIPA/industry totals for digital cameras vs IDC/global smartphone shipments. Watch the compact-camera collapse as phones explode after the iPhone era, then settle into the smartphone-dominant landscape by 2026.
youtube_description: When Phones Ate Cameras — The dramatic rise of smartphone cameras and the collapse of the compact camera industry, told in one brutal chart race. Using industry shipment totals (CIPA for cameras, IDC for smartphones) from 2006 through 2026, this video traces the moment the mobile camera became good enough for most people, and how that single shift crushed a multi-billion-unit industry. Key moments included the iPhone launch in 2007, the mid-2010s boom in smartphone camera quality, the compact-camera washout after 2012, and a mirrorless niche recovery in the late 2010s. Watch how phones skyrocket while cameras plummet — and what remains for dedicated shooters. Like, subscribe, and comment which year surprised you most. Hit the bell to catch the full animation drop. #whenphonesatecameras #cameradeath #smartphoneboom #chartrace #dataviz
